title: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. 8-K Filing — Stock Repurchase Program
summary: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. (MNSB), a small Virginia-based regional bank listed on Nasdaq, announced a new $10 million stock repurchase program on April 24, 2026, replacing its previous program from October 2025. The company retains discretion over timing, pricing, and execution of purchases.
key_points: Company: MainStreet Bancshares, Inc., Nasdaq-listed (tickers: MNSB, MNSBP)
New repurchase program authorized: up to $10 million
Previous program announced October 21, 2025, is superseded by new program
Management has full discretion over purchase timing, quantity, and price
Purchases may be made on open market, in privately negotiated transactions, or other compliant methods
Program may be extended, modified, suspended, or discontinued at any time
